Jacob Nachinson — Official Clipping Campaign
Jacob Nachinson — Official Clipping Campaign
Create valuable short-form clips from Jacob Nachinson’s YouTube content that make viewers want to watch the full video.
Platforms: YouTube Shorts • TikTok • Instagram Reels
Source channel: Jacob Nachinson on YouTube
Campaign requirements
At least 40% of viewers must be from the United States / Tier 1 countries.
Use dedicated accounts for this campaign.
Only clip videos from Jacob Nachinson’s YouTube channel.
Videos must be longer than 10 seconds.
Tag @jacobnach on every video.
Add the required logo to every video. Logo / campaign assets
Include Jacob’s YouTube channel link in your bio.
Make sure every link is clickable, or your submission may be rejected.
Every clip must provide value or education. Rizz, aura, glow edits, and skull edits will be rejected.
Account bio
Your bio must start with:
Main YT: @jacobnach
​
Add one of these above your YouTube link:
Best Health/wellness page out here
Learn more about health with @jacobnach
A similar natural variation.
Required bio link: https://www.youtube.com/@jacobnach
Caption requirement
Your caption must begin with:
@jacobnach on YouTube
​
Do not put spam or unrelated text on the same line.
Content ideas
Focus on fitness, mindset, self-improvement, motivation, storytelling, and educational tips.
Every video should have:
A strong hook
Fast pacing
Clean subtitles
High-retention editing
Not allowed
Commentary-style videos
Low-quality or AI slop content
Fake views or botted analytics
Reposting other creators’ edits — create your own
Duplicate submissions — detectable and subject to an automatic ban
How to get paid
Post your video.
Submit it to Whop within 30 minutes.
After 24–48 hours, send your video analytics to the Support chat.
Payments are processed automatically through Content Rewards.

 Name things the way you'd search for them. A clip called door to door days.mov or an album called Overtime startup footage beats anything the AI guesses, and both now rank first in search.
